name: Article Hero
summary: Passive native article header with a required contextual title, optional target media and metadata, and three intrinsic editorial variants.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native passive header that introduces the surrounding article without creating a new section or landmark.

anatomy.name: layout
anatomy.description: Private media/content layout that responds to the root inline-size container.

anatomy.name: backgroundMedia
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned media region for the full-image variant.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Visual-only private contrast layer rendered only with full background media.

anatomy.name: splitMedia
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned media region for the split variant.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Article category, contextual heading, and target metadata flow.

anatomy.name: category
anatomy.description: Optional compact article-context label; destination policy remains target-owned.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Complete contextual heading whose rank is selected by the target composition.

anatomy.name: metadata
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted publication, author, duration, or taxonomy metadata.

anatomy.name: metadataSeparator
anatomy.description: Optional visual-only separator between target metadata values.

variants.name: full
variants.description: Full-width media presentation with a private contrast overlay and complete overlaid content.

variants.name: split
variants.description: Media/content composition that splits only when its own container has sufficient inline space.

variants.name: text-only
variants.description: Centered bounded article introduction that never requires media.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid intrinsic size controlled by the parent and Article Hero container.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive complete article introduction with a required contextual heading.

states.name: withoutSelectedMedia
states.description: Full or split mode lacks its selected media and fails closed to readable normal text without an empty track or inverse-on-transparent content.

behavior.name: nativeArticleHeader
behavior.description: Use a native header and one contextual heading selected by the surrounding document; do not add a Hero widget role, landmark, or keyboard model.

behavior.name: contextualMedia
behavior.description: The target supplies informative alternative text or an explicit empty value according to the image's role in context.

behavior.name: visualOnlyOverlay
behavior.description: The full-image contrast layer is private presentation, rendered only with media and hidden from assistive technology.

behavior.name: targetMetadata
behavior.description: Dates, durations, authors, taxonomy, locale, ordering, and optional child destinations are supplied by the target; machine-readable time values are retained where applicable.

behavior.name: readableMediaFallback
behavior.description: A missing selected media slot never produces inverse text on transparency, a forced empty column, hidden title content, or a substituted image. Unsupported variant input normalizes to full before this safe state is derived.

behavior.name: intrinsicVariantLayout
behavior.description: Variant layout responds to the Article Hero named inline-size container without viewport assumptions, reordered DOM, or Studio overrides.

behavior.name: contentCompleteness
behavior.description: Complete title and optional context wrap naturally without source clamps, generated ellipsis, or runtime measurement.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Neutral Article Hero owns no JavaScript, request, observer, timer, storage, focus behavior, animation loop, analytics, or structured-data emission.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: One of the three accepted Article Hero presentation profiles.

properties.name: backgroundMedia
properties.unsetBehavior: Full mode adds the private without-media state and renders a readable normal-text header; other variants ignore this slot.
properties.description: Target-owned picture, image, or media composition for full mode.

properties.name: splitMedia
properties.unsetBehavior: Split mode adds the private without-media state and renders one readable content column; other variants ignore this slot.
properties.description: Target-owned picture, image, or media composition for split mode.

properties.name: category
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the category paragraph when no compact article-context label is supplied.
properties.description: Optional article-context label; links and taxonomy records remain target-owned.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Complete visible article title rendered in one target-selected contextual heading.

properties.name: metadata
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the metadata wrapper when no target-formatted values are supplied.
properties.description: Target-owned publication date, duration, author, or taxonomy composition; use machine-readable time elements where applicable.

accessibility: Use a native header within the target article/page and exactly one complete contextual heading whose rank follows the surrounding document; do not add a Hero widget role, tabindex, live region, or custom keyboard model.
Provide contextual informative alt text for meaningful media or an explicit empty alt value when decorative; full versus split placement does not determine image meaning.
Keep full-image category, title, and metadata contrast compliant over every responsive crop and theme; use split or text-only when media cannot support readable overlaid text.
Use machine-readable time datetime values for supplied dates and durations, hide visual-only separators from assistive technology, and preserve normal DOM reading order.

Preserve complete wrapping title and metadata content through narrow containers, effective 200 percent text, RTL/localization, forced colors, and reduced-motion settings without horizontal overflow or motion dependency.

web.notes: Native header/contextual heading markup, target slots, private readable no-media state, and CSS-only named-container variants; no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: The article-hero snippet maps Shopify article title, image, author, and published timestamp with explicit variant, heading, label, visibility, alt-policy, sizes, and loading inputs; it adds no inferred duration, taxonomy, JavaScript, or structured data.

react.notes: Preserve passive native semantics and target-owned heading rank, media, metadata, locale, and routing composition.

figma.notes: Needs corrected L2-specific three-variant, no-media, long-content, and overlay artwork; registered nodes currently reference generic Button shells.
